name: pinterest-ads-mcp
description: Pinterest Ads (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, get_report, update_budget, pause_resume. Eve

platform_mcp_pinterest_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_PINTEREST_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_pinterest_client_id.description: Pinterest app id; HTTP Basic username on POST https://api.pinterest.com/v5/oauth/token.

platform_mcp_pinterest_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_PINTEREST_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_pinterest_client_secret.description: Pinterest app secret key; HTTP Basic password on the token request.

platform_mcp_pinterest_refresh_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_PINTEREST_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_pinterest_refresh_token.description: Refresh token (starts with `pinr`) from the authorization-code flow with scopes user_accounts:read, ads:read and ads:write. Continuous refresh tokens last 60 days and every refresh returns a new one: the runtime keeps the rotated token in memory, and when PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR is set it saves it to <dir>/pinterest.json (mode 0600) and prefers it over this variable on the next start.

platform_mcp_pinterest_ad_account_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_PINTEREST_AD_ACCOUNT_ID
platform_mcp_pinterest_ad_account_id.description: Ad account id (digits) that update_budget and pause_resume PATCH (PATCH /v5/ad_accounts/{ad_account_id}/campaigns); those verbs take only a campaign id.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /v5/user_account: the account behind the token (username, account_type, business_name, ...).

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: GET /v5/ad_accounts?page_size=250 (the maximum; list_accounts takes no paging arguments; shared accounts included by default). Paging is by `bookmark`; only the first page is returned.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: GET /v5/ad_accounts/{ad_account_id}/campaigns. `status` is sent as entity_statuses (ACTIVE, PAUSED, ARCHIVED, DRAFT, DELETED_DRAFT; default ACTIVE+PAUSED). Budgets (daily_spend_cap, lifetime_spend_cap) are micro-currency integers and start_time/end_time Unix seconds, left in raw. Paging is by `bookmark`; only the first page is returned.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: GET /v5/ad_accounts/{ad_account_id}/campaigns/analytics?start_date&end_date&campaign_ids&columns&granularity=DAY (dates YYYY-MM-DD, up to 90 days back). campaign_ids is REQUIRED by Pinterest, so pass campaign_id. Returns one object per campaign per day.

tools.name: update_budget
tools.description: PATCH /v5/ad_accounts/{ad_account_id (config)}/campaigns [{id, daily_spend_cap}]. daily_spend_cap is an integer in MICRO-currency of the advertiser's currency (e.g. 25000000 = 25.00) and applies to campaign-budget-optimization campaigns (ad-group budgets must stay 0/unset). `currency` is ignored. A rejected item (exceptions, no data) is reported as invalid_input.

tools.name: pause_resume
tools.description: PATCH /v5/ad_accounts/{ad_account_id (config)}/campaigns [{id, status: PAUSED|ACTIVE}]. Returns the updated campaign's status; a rejected item (exceptions, no data) is reported as invalid_input.
